description: Mouse counterpart to pad_deploy_reposition_rotate_model: Shift+click lifts an already-placed model and Q/E must rotate THAT model, not the ghost waiting for the next one. Drives the real player path on a 3-model unit — two models placed with real board clicks (so one model is still pending and ghost_sprite is alive), Shift+click on model 0 to lift it, four 'E' taps, then a plain click to drop. Asserts the three halves of the 2026-07-30 report: (1) the lifted model's ghost takes the rotation and ghost_sprite's facing is untouched — before the fix every rotate input went to ghost_sprite, so the player watched the wrong model spin; (2) ghost_sprite is HIDDEN while a model is in hand — _process stops tracking it during a lift, so it used to sit frozen at the pick-up point, which is what read as 'the old position is still visible'; (3) the drop commits the new facing into temp_rotations, not just the new position.
